name: Classic Oats & Eggs
instructions: Whisk eggs & whites in an oven-safe bowl. Airfry 180C/8min. Microwave oats with water/cinnamon.

name: Greek Yogurt Bowl
ingredients: 250g Greek yogurt 2%, 1 scoop whey, 1 banana, 20g almonds
instructions: Mix whey into yogurt. Top with sliced banana and crushed almonds.

name: Airfryer Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 220g chicken breast, 220g boiled basmati, 15g olive oil

name: Turkey & Sweet Potato
ingredients: 220g turkey breast, 300g sweet potato cubes, 15g olive oil

name: Whey & Fruit
ingredients: 1 scoop whey protein, 1 medium apple or banana, water
instructions: Shake whey with water. Eat fruit on the side.

name: Beef Strips & Veggies
ingredients: 220g lean beef (5% fat) strips, 200g rice, peppers
instructions: Airfry beef strips 190C/10min. Serve with rice and peppers.

name: Vegan Oats & Tahini
ingredients: 30g vegan protein, 60g oats, almond milk, 15g tahini
instructions: Mix protein with almond milk, stir in oats, top with tahini.

name: Crispy Chickpeas & Bread
ingredients: 250g canned chickpeas, 120g whole wheat bread, 15g olive oil
instructions: Drain chickpeas, toss in olive oil & spices. Airfry 190C/12min until crispy.

name: Soy Yogurt & Vegan Pro
ingredients: 200g soy yogurt, 20g vegan protein, 1 large apple
instructions: Mix vegan protein powder into soy yogurt.

name: Crispy Tofu & Lentils
ingredients: 150g firm tofu, 250g cooked lentils, 10g olive oil
instructions: Press tofu, cube, toss with olive oil/soy sauce. Airfry 200C/15min.

name: Garlic Shrimp & Rice
instructions: Toss shrimp in olive oil & garlic powder. Airfry 200C/8min.

name: Vegan Oats & Tahini+
ingredients: 50g vegan protein, 45g oats, 250ml soy milk, 15g tahini
instructions: +20g protein powder, oats 60g->45g. Mix protein with soy milk, stir in oats, top with tahini.

name: Chickpeas, Edamame & Bread
ingredients: 250g canned chickpeas, 150g shelled edamame, 60g whole wheat bread, 10g olive oil
instructions: +150g edamame, bread 120g->60g, oil 15g->10g. Airfry chickpeas 190C/12min; steam edamame.

name: Soy Yogurt & Vegan Pro+
ingredients: 200g soy yogurt, 35g vegan protein, 1 large apple
instructions: +15g protein powder. Mix into soy yogurt.

name: Crispy Tofu & Lentils+
ingredients: 250g firm tofu, 200g cooked lentils, 5g olive oil

name: Garlic Shrimp & Rice+
instructions: Shrimp 200g->250g. Toss in olive oil & garlic powder. Airfry 200C/8min.
